package teacherdialog_test

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestT14WorkerNeverReadsMutableCourseForFrozenSource(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	request := jobs.job.Request
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	jobs.job.Request = request
	builder.value = domain.StudentContext{StudentID: request.StudentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: request.ContextID}
	dialog.context.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	dialog.context.LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""
	var source domain.LessonMessageContext
	raw := map[string]string{"schema": "lesson-message-context.v2", "mode": "lesson_overview", "course_id": "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", "lesson_id": request.ContextID, "content_revision": "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc", "learning_path_id": "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd", "learning_path_item_id": "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee", "content_digest": "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
	data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &source))
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LessonContext = &source
	course := &courseLessonReader{content: domain.CourseLessonContent{LessonID: request.ContextID, CourseID: raw["course_id"], Language: "ru", Title: "Published R2", ContentRevision: "2026-10-04T00:00:00Z"}}
	worker.CourseLessons = course
	worker.PromptContext = t14UncheckedPrompt{}
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.Zero(t, course.calls, "a frozen request must never consult current Course content")
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
}

// Isolate the Worker provider dispatch from the earlier timestamp-only decoder.
// A zero prompt snapshot is sufficient: the wrong Course read happens before
// generation validation and must be absent for every frozen source.
type t14UncheckedPrompt struct{}

func (t14UncheckedPrompt) Build(context.Context, domain.DialogRequestContext, string, time.Time) (domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext, error) {
	return domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, nil
}

type assignedLessonReader struct {
	content                   domain.AssignedLessonContext
	err                       error
	calls                     int
	studentID, pathID, itemID string
}

func (reader *assignedLessonReader) GetAssignedLessonContext(_ context.Context, studentID, pathID, itemID string) (domain.AssignedLessonContext, error) {
	reader.calls++
	reader.studentID, reader.pathID, reader.itemID = studentID, pathID, itemID
	return reader.content, reader.err
}
func t14FrozenWorker(t *testing.T, mode domain.LessonMessageMode) (teacherdialog.Worker, *workerJobs, *dialogBoundary, *responseGenerator, *assignedLessonReader, *courseLessonReader) {
	t.Helper()
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	request := jobs.job.Request
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	jobs.job.Request = request
	builder.value = domain.StudentContext{StudentID: request.StudentID, ContextType: request.ContextType, ContextID: request.ContextID}
	dialog.context.ContextType = request.ContextType
	dialog.context.LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""
	content := domain.AssignedLessonContext{Schema: domain.AssignedLessonContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: request.StudentID, LearningPathID: "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd", LearningPathItemID: "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee", CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LessonID: request.ContextID, LessonRevisionID: "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc", Content: domain.AssignedLessonContent{Title: "  Frozen R1  ", Excerpt: "  Frozen public overview  ", Description: "Frozen R1 uses errors.Is(err, target), never published R2."}}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal([3]string{content.Content.Title, content.Content.Excerpt, content.Content.Description})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	content.ContentDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	source := &domain.LessonMessageContext{Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersionV2, Mode: mode, CourseID: content.CourseID, LessonID: content.LessonID, ContentRevision: content.LessonRevisionID, LearningPathID: content.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: content.LearningPathItemID, ContentDigest: content.ContentDigest}
	if mode == domain.LessonMessageModeSelection {
		source.SelectedText = "errors.Is(err, target)"
	}
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LessonContext = source
	assigned := &assignedLessonReader{content: content}
	current := &courseLessonReader{err: domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable}
	worker.AssignedLessons = assigned
	worker.CourseLessons = current
	return worker, jobs, dialog, generator, assigned, current
}
func TestT14WorkerUsesStudentFrozenProjectionAfterMutablePublication(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []domain.LessonMessageMode{domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, domain.LessonMessageModeSelection} {
		t.Run(string(mode), func(t *testing.T) {
			worker, jobs, _, generator, assigned, current := t14FrozenWorker(t, mode)
			claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
			require.True(t, claimed)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, 1, assigned.calls)
			require.Zero(t, current.calls)
			require.Equal(t, jobs.job.Request.StudentID, assigned.studentID)
			require.Equal(t, assigned.content.LearningPathID, assigned.pathID)
			require.Equal(t, assigned.content.LearningPathItemID, assigned.itemID)
			require.Equal(t, 1, generator.generated)
			require.NotEmpty(t, jobs.completedMessage)
			require.Equal(t, assigned.content.ContentDigest, generator.request.Lesson.ContentDigest)
			require.Equal(t, assigned.content.LessonRevisionID, generator.request.Lesson.ContentRevision)
			if mode == domain.LessonMessageModeOverview {
				require.Equal(t, assigned.content.Content.Title, generator.request.Lesson.Title)
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, "errors.Is(err, target)", generator.request.Lesson.SelectedText)
				require.Empty(t, generator.request.Lesson.Title)
			}
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(generator.request.Lesson)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NotContains(t, string(encoded), assigned.content.Content.Description)
		})
	}
}
func TestT14WorkerBlocksForeignMissingAndUnavailableAssignedContextWithoutFallback(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"owner", "path", "item", "course", "lesson", "revision", "digest", "fragment", "missing", "outage", "nil reader"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			worker, jobs, dialog, generator, assigned, current := t14FrozenWorker(t, domain.LessonMessageModeSelection)
			foreign := "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
			switch name {
			case "owner":
				assigned.content.StudentID = foreign
			case "path":
				assigned.content.LearningPathID = foreign
			case "item":
				assigned.content.LearningPathItemID = foreign
			case "course":
				assigned.content.CourseID = foreign
			case "lesson":
				assigned.content.LessonID = foreign
			case "revision":
				assigned.content.LessonRevisionID = foreign
			case "digest":
				assigned.content.ContentDigest = "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
			case "fragment":
				dialog.context.Messages[0].LessonContext.SelectedText = "not frozen"
			case "missing":
				assigned.err = domain.ErrLessonContextNotFound
			case "outage":
				assigned.err = domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable
			case "nil reader":
				worker.AssignedLessons = nil
			}
			claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
			require.True(t, claimed)
			require.Error(t, err)
			require.Zero(t, current.calls)
			require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
			require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
			require.Empty(t, jobs.savedBody)
			if name == "outage" || name == "nil reader" {
				require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, jobs.retriedCode)
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, jobs.blockedCode)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestT14FrozenPendingDeliveryReplayDoesNotReloadStudentOrCourse(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, assigned, current := t14FrozenWorker(t, domain.LessonMessageModeOverview)
	jobs.job.ResponseBody = "already generated"
	jobs.job.DecisionID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	assigned.err = domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Zero(t, assigned.calls)
	require.Zero(t, current.calls)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.readCalls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.appendCalls)
}
